name: doc-decision-log
description: Keeps a Decision Log as a dated table of short records with context, options considered, decision, decider, status, consequences and a link to the memo or notes, superseding old entries instead of editing them. Use for "run doc-decision-log", "log this decision", "decision log", "why did we decide this", "we already decided this", "decisions keep getting reopened", "decision history for the team", "supersede an old decision", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
